parts.title: A Visit to the Meadow
parts.text: Ila, Joaquin, and Tamsin visited their aunt's meadow. Near an old oak tree stood a wooden bee **hive**. The air was full of the soft **hum** of bees. “Stay calm and move slowly,” said their aunt. “Bees will not **sting** unless they feel scared.”

parts.title: Busy Bees
parts.text: The bees were **industrious**, and they worked from morning until evening. Many flew out to **forage** for food in the pink **clover**. Tamsin saw yellow **pollen** stuck to their little legs. Joaquin pointed to a fuzzy **bumblebee**. Its wings seemed to **vibrate** so fast that they looked like a blur.

parts.title: Inside the Hive
parts.text: Their aunt lifted the lid very slowly. Inside, the bees had built tiny six-sided rooms from **wax**. The sweet **scent** of honey filled the air. “That big bee is a **drone**,” she whispered. “He does not gather food. The worker bees do that.”

parts.title: Walking Home
parts.text: The children thanked their aunt and walked home. They had learned that a hive is like a tiny town where every bee has a job. Tamsin said she would plant flowers for the bees at home.

definitions.meaning1: A fine yellow dust made by flowers. Bees carry it from flower to flower. Example: Yellow pollen dusted the bee's legs.

definitions.meaning1: A small green plant with round pink or white flowers and leaves in groups of three. Example: Bees love the sweet flowers of clover.

definitions.meaning1: To go looking for food. Example: Squirrels forage for nuts in the fall.

definitions.meaning1: To shake with very quick, tiny movements. Example: My phone will vibrate when a message comes in.

definitions.meaning1: A smell, especially a nice one. Example: The sweet scent of flowers drifted through the window.

definitions.meaning1: A big, fuzzy bee with a loud buzz. Example: A bumblebee landed on the purple flower.

definitions.meaning1: A male bee that does not gather food or make honey. Example: The drone stays in the hive while the workers collect food.
definitions.meaning2: A low, steady humming sound. Example: We heard the drone of a plane far above.
